verdicts.note: Direction holds against a sitting sheriff: he has never held elected public office [S1], has about a decade in law enforcement [S1][S3], and is challenging his own boss [S8]. High confidence overstates the renewal case, though. The dossier records no explicit call for change or new voices; his pamphlet statement rests on experience, saying he is prepared 'because of the full scope of my experience' [S1], and his profile is a career deputy, sergeant and SWAT assistant commander [S1][S3]. The renewal placement is structural (challenger vs incumbent), not a stated outsider pitch, so +1 at medium, consistent with the Grant sheriff refutation for Darrik Gregg.
